programme.desc: Accompanied by freestyle champion Deborah Scanzio, we set off by bike from Pescium following the Strada degli Alpi, a fabulous route along which we discover a fascinating crystal cave.

programme.title: E6 - Flying Over The Mountains
programme.desc: To learn more about backcountry skiing, Alexis and Thomas travel to Golden, British Columbia, where they experience two extremes: the luxury of heliskiing and the simple life of 'ski bums.'

programme.title: E1 - The Foundations
programme.desc: Laurelle and Alexis embark on building a house resistant to climate change. In Estrie, a visit is made to the construction site of a blended family whose project is to build a house insulated with hemp concrete.

programme.title: E15 - Charlotte Buhler (Paris)/Maxime And Yannis Alary (London)
programme.desc: Richard Orlinski heads to Rue de la Roquette in Paris, in the vibrant, cosmopolitan, tourist-friendly and lively Bastille district, to meet Charlotte Buhler. With her brother, the young woman has created Brother Sister, a place that celebrates Californian cuisine, combining creativity and a family spirit. Originally from Normandy, brothers Maxime and Yannis Alary have settled in London, where they opened the bistro Blanchette in the heart of Soho. Welcome to a place in their image, deeply inspired by the French art of living!

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: In this episode of Spiky Gold Hunters, the crew of the San Nicholas are heading to the southern most part of Stewart Island, the last stop before Antarctica. Despite the icy waters and cold conditions, the competition between the divers is fierce although for one member of the team it will be their last trip.

programme.title: E1 - Anthony Joshua
programme.desc: Adventurer Bear Grylls teaches the unified world heavyweight champion some alternative survival skills.

programme.title: E1 - Ho Chi Minh City
programme.desc: Home to more than 5 million motorbikes, Ho Chi Minh City is a veritable river of two-wheelers where drivers carry everything from windows and doors to entire families on their scooters.

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: In this episode of Spiky Gold Hunters, skipper Dwayne and the crew head to a consistent urchin dive spot. A keen young dingy boy, George, endures a baptism of fire as the team tries to fill a backlog of orders. With the demand turned up to maximum and a unique food festival to provide for, everyone on the boat is fighting for the top spot of bringing in the biggest amount of urchin.

programme.title: E4 - Brisbane Raid

programme.title: E3 - Wild Fortresses
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. programme.title: E5 - Creepiest Crawlies
programme.desc: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

programme.desc: 少年王樹文被誘騙頂罪，當真相即將大白，關鍵證人卻接連身亡，巡撫李鶴年與軍機處聯手施壓，妄圖將冤案坐實；兩位清官在法理與人情間陷入殊死較量，一封信，一次覺醒，一場關於過而能改的官道傳承，在濁浪中驚心上演。

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: E74
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: E22
programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。
